Greatness begins in silence

This is the story of how a single ingredient, cultivated with patience, became a global standard of excellence.

ONE ICON
STARTED IT...
A legendary sauce that has conquered the globe
The bottle that started it all. A simple, powerful combination of three ingredients that has conquered over 195 countries. It is the definitive choice for those who seek authentic flavor and an unmistakable kick of heat.

This is the most recognized hot sauce in history. From professional kitchens to family tables, this bottle has become the universal reference for spice, maintaining the exact same quality and character since its creation in 1868.
